Pakistan President Declares Emergency in KPK, Suspends Provincial Government

Pakistan's President has declared an emergency in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KPK) province, leading to the cessation of the provincial government. This action involves the suspension of the provincial government led by Imran Khan's party.
